label: None
observable_criteria: No community engagement conducted

label: Inform
observable_criteria: One-way information sessions; no feedback mechanism; fact sheets and public notices only

label: Consult
observable_criteria: Public comment periods; structured feedback collection; surveys and open houses with documented responses

label: Collaborate/Empower
observable_criteria: Multi-year participatory process; community co-design of retreat plan; shared decision-making authority or community-led governance

label: Mandatory
observable_criteria: Compulsory acquisition or eminent domain with no opt-out; residents must relocate

label: Incentivized
observable_criteria: Buyout offers with financial incentives but strong administrative pressure; limited alternative support if declined

label: Voluntary with encouragement
observable_criteria: Voluntary buyout program with active outreach and support services; no penalty for non-participation

label: Fully voluntary
observable_criteria: Open enrollment with right of refusal; residents retain full autonomy; program adapts to community pace

label: Universal/untargeted
observable_criteria: First-come first-served with no demographic or income criteria; uniform program access

label: Needs-aware
observable_criteria: Income or vulnerability data collected; used for outreach prioritization but not resource allocation

label: Needs-weighted
observable_criteria: Explicit allocation formula weighting resources toward low-income or socially vulnerable households; tiered compensation

label: Equity-first
observable_criteria: Vulnerable populations receive first access and highest support levels; program design co-developed with affected communities; explicit anti-displacement safeguards

label: None
observable_criteria: No relocation support beyond financial compensation

label: Financial only
observable_criteria: Compensation payment plus basic referral information; no active case management

label: Financial + relocation
observable_criteria: Compensation plus active relocation assistance: housing search support; moving logistics; school enrollment and utility transfer help

label: Full wraparound
observable_criteria: Compensation plus relocation plus ongoing support: mental health counseling; job placement; community rebuilding programs; long-term follow-up

label: No commitment
observable_criteria: Cleared land left vacant or sold for private redevelopment with no ecological conditions

label: Basic stabilization
observable_criteria: Demolition and site clearance; erosion control; invasive species management; no active restoration

label: Active restoration
observable_criteria: Native habitat restoration with planting and grading; stormwater management; public access where appropriate

label: Long-term stewardship
observable_criteria: Active restoration plus funded long-term monitoring; adaptive management plan; conservation easement or land trust transfer; ecosystem service valuation and reporting

label: No opposition
observable_criteria: Broad community support or indifference; no organized resistance

label: Low opposition
observable_criteria: Scattered individual complaints; occasional negative media coverage; no organized groups

label: Moderate opposition
observable_criteria: Organized petition drives or comment campaigns; public protests; formal objections in administrative proceedings

label: High opposition
observable_criteria: Active legal challenges; sustained protest or civil disobedience; political mobilization to block program; widespread non-participation

label: No perceived inequity
observable_criteria: Compensation and support seen as fair across demographics; no disparities in program access or outcomes

label: Low perceived inequity
observable_criteria: Minor concerns about fairness raised in public comment; no systematic disparities documented

label: Moderate perceived inequity
observable_criteria: Documented disparities in compensation ratios or service access across income or racial groups; media coverage of fairness concerns

label: High perceived inequity
observable_criteria: Large systematic disparities in outcomes; formal discrimination complaints or civil rights challenges; community trust breakdown along demographic lines
